Create the genesis of a new chain
Usage: telcoin genesis [OPTIONS]
Options:
      --datadir <DATADIR>
      --chain-id <CHAIN_ID>
      --bls-passphrase-source <SOURCE>
      --accounts <ACCOUNTS>
      --epoch-duration-in-secs <SECS>
      --min-header-delay-ms <MS>
      --max-header-delay-ms <MS>
